headline: Built your way,
to your spec.
copy.sub: Extensions, roofs, garden rooms, landscaping and kitchens across Folkestone and Kent. Clear, itemised quotes and a tidy site every day.
copy.about_alt: Sean on site with the frame of a garden building going up
copy.lede: Sean runs Your Spec Home Improvements, an all-round builder working across Kent. One customer in Folkestone had him clear and rebuild their garden, repair the chimney and fit a new kitchen in one summer, with clear itemised quotes and the site kept tidy throughout.
copy.services_intro: Inside, outside and up on the roof.

services.title: Extensions and alterations
services.blurb: Extensions, knock-throughs with new steels, and alterations to make the house work for you.
services.intro: Openings made, steels in, and the room built back up ready to finish.

services.title: Roofing and chimneys
services.blurb: Slating, extension roofs, chimney repairs, flaunching, repointing, lead work and cowls.
services.intro: Roofs and chimneys put right before the weather gets in.

services.title: Garden rooms
services.blurb: Timber garden rooms and summer houses framed, roofed and clad on a solid base.
services.intro: Extra space in the garden for an office, gym or somewhere to sit.

services.title: Landscaping and turf
services.blurb: Overgrown gardens cleared, sleeper retaining walls, topsoil and fresh turf or artificial grass.
services.intro: A garden you can actually use, cleared and rebuilt from the ground up.

services.title: Patios and paths
services.blurb: Porcelain and stone patios, steps and resin-bound paths.
services.intro: Laid level, with proper falls so the water runs away.

services.title: Kitchens, fencing and gates
services.blurb: Old kitchens out and new ones fitted with appliances, plus fences, walls and handmade gates.
services.intro: The finishing jobs, done by the same builder, with the waste taken away.

steps.title: Cleared
steps.text: Overgrown trees and greenery out, old walls down, sleepers in to hold the levels.

steps.title: Turfed
steps.text: Fresh topsoil and new turf. The same garden as the first photo.

steps.title: Framed
steps.text: A garden building going up on a solid base, every post plumb.

steps.title: Roofed
steps.text: Roof boarded and weathertight before anything goes inside.

steps.title: Finished
steps.text: Clad, glazed and set on a new patio with lawn either side.

reviews: I had a lot of work done by the guys on the front and back of my property very hard working and doing the work to a high standard would recomend then

Sean from Your Spec Home Improvements has done several jobs for us at our family home in Folkestone over the summer. First he transformed the back garden... He then repaired the chimney... Most recently he took out our old kitchen and fitted a new one. His quotes were clear and itemised, his prices were fair, and he did what he said he would. I'd happily recommend Sean to anyone in Kent looking for a reliable all-round builder.
faqs: Yes. Send a few details and photos and you'll get a clear, itemised quote.
We're based in Kent and work across Folkestone, Hythe, Dover, Ashford, Canterbury and nearby.
Can you take on several jobs at once?
Yes. Garden, roof and kitchen can all be done by the same builder, one after another.
Do you take the waste away?
Yes, waste is cleared away and the site is kept tidy.
